_provenance.notes: The Copper River salmon season is Alaska's most media-visible commercial fishery event. The first-day opener in mid-May generates enormous national media attention due to Copper River Chinook's status as 'the world's most expensive commercially-caught fish.' ADF&G manages the Copper River fishery with extremely precise in-season sonar counts. The 2023 season was notable because opener prices hit $7.99/lb at retail before any fish touched a boat.
